definitions.explanation: Differences or unevenness among items that are supposed to be similar — in measurements, product quality, individual abilities, performance, etc. Common in technical, statistical, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ばらつき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is variation in the results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ばらつき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to reduce the variation in quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばらつき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧、⟦{平均点|へいきんてん}→平均点：21466_heikinten⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: There is large variation in the students' grades, so the average alone doesn't show the real picture.

notes:
Noun form of the verb ばらつく (to be scattered, vary). Usually written in hiragana even in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばらつき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is variation
- ばらつき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: variation is large
- ばらつき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress variation
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ばらつき: variation in quality
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ばらつき: scatter in the data

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference — between two specific things, not spread across many
- むら: unevenness — broader and more colloquial; often for color, mood, work
- ⟦{分散|ぶんさん}→分散：18624_bunsan⟧: variance (statistical) — the formal mathematical measure
